chapter_notes.counterintuitive_insight: Frame systems look simple until repair happens; then the core problem is memory overwriting, not slot extraction.
covered_claims: This appendix complements chapter 25 with explicit frame-state tracking.

failure_modes.note: Anything outside the predefined slot set is invisible to a frame tracker.
A frame system fails if it cannot overwrite stale slot values after repair.
